treatments.label: Establish Pharmaceutical Manufacturing Quality & Supply Continuity Program
treatments.description: Operationalize a pharmaceutical quality system for drug product manufacturing aligned with ICH Q10 and FDA Quality Metrics, separating production (drug substance generation) from distribution (dispensing/logistics) to harden supply continuity and prevent shortage propagation.
treatments.cite: ICH (2008). Q10 Pharmaceutical Quality System. International Council for Harmonisation; Woodcock, J. & Wosinska, M. (2013). Economic and Technological Drivers of Generic Sterile Injectable Drug Shortages. Clinical Pharmacology & Therapeutics, 93(2), 170-176. doi:10.1038/clpt.2012.220

citation.author: Woodcock, J. & Wosinska, M.
citation.title: Economic and Technological Drivers of Generic Sterile Injectable Drug Shortages

steps: Map drug product manufacturing nodes (production) separately from dispensing and PBM/EHR logistics nodes (distribution)
Implement ICH Q10 pharmaceutical quality system across drug substance and biologic production lines
Establish FDA Quality Metrics monitoring for batch release, deviation, and out-of-specification rates
Build redundancy and second-source qualification for critical drug products to prevent shortage propagation
Measure supply continuity, batch right-first-time, and shortage incidence outcomes
treatments.monitoring: PHASE 1 (Weeks 1-4): Baseline — drug product batch right-first-time rate and active shortage count using FDA Drug Shortage database. Deliverable: baseline report. PHASE 2 (Months 2-3): Early tracking — batch right-first-time measured monthly. Target: 95% right-first-time. PHASE 3 (Months 4-6): Midpoint review — compare against FDA Quality Metrics benchmark. Target: 50% reduction in deviations. PHASE 4 (Months 7-12): Maturation — supply continuity trending toward zero critical-product shortages. Escalate if any single-source critical product remains unqualified. ANNUAL REVIEW: Comprehensive quality system audit using ICH Q10 framework. Report to Manufacturing Quality Director.
treatments.escalation: If a critical drug product enters shortage, or if batch right-first-time falls below the 90% floor for >14 consecutive days, escalate to a pharmaceutical manufacturing quality director for root cause analysis and second-source activation. If a drug product quality defect threatens patient safety, initiate recall review within 24 hours.
